fuel_consumption.source_quote: Estimated 2006 fuel consumption ~107 million gallons per item7a sensitivity disclosure.

instrument_type_details.notes: Fuel hedge collars on jet fuel as cash flow hedges under SFAS 133. Coverage for 2007 at Dec 31, 2006: Q1=~26% (floor $2.35/ceiling $2.51/gal Gulf Coast Mean incl. into-plane); Q2=~26%; Q3=~11.8%; Q4=0%. Weighted avg ~21.3% for first three quarters. In 2006 realized $2.2M expense from fuel falling below collar floor. At Dec 31, 2006: $4.5M liability in current accrued liabilities. SUBSEQUENT EVENT (January 2007): Significantly increased hedge position to ~90% of 2007 fuel at avg ~$2.06/gal (major strategic decision). Convertible notes FV $30.4M vs. book $21.6M.

throughput.source_quote: Aircraft fuel, oil and associated taxes of $232.0 million in 2006 increased $53.9 million, or 30.3%. Into-plane fuel prices increased 16.6% in 2006, averaging $2.17 per gallon versus $1.86 per gallon in 2005. Fuel consumption increased 11.3 million gallons. [Derived: $232.0M / $2.17 = 106.9M gallons; confirmed: 95.8 + 11.3 = 107.1M]
